description: Premium Textile Mills Limited was founded in 1986 by industrialist Kadir Adam and describes itself as having grown from a textile company into a business spanning garment manufacturing, trading and auto parts. It spins yarn — including fancy and mélange yarns — and manufactures socks and hosiery for sports, active recreation and specialty markets, from a unit it describes as Industry 4.0 and USGBC LEED certified. The company lists Pinnacle Fiber (Private) Limited and Prudential Enterprises among its associated companies.
headOffice: 1st Floor, Haji Adam Chambers, Altaf Hussain Road, New Challi, Karachi, Pakistan

products.name: Fancy and mélange yarn
products.summary: Mélange yarns blending raw cotton with dyed fibres in PC/CVC from Ne 10/1 to Ne 40/1, heather greys, and fancy yarns including injection, snow-effect, marled/grindle and speckled/neppy varieties.

products.name: Socks and hosiery
products.summary: Performance socks (walking, running, ski and snow, hiking, sports), lifestyle socks (casual, everyday, dress, formal) and specialty socks (diabetic, work thermal, comfort, medicated, over-the-knee), made on machines the company describes as Industry 4.0 with seamless toe linking.
